description: Android activity class for browsing Wiktionary content, handling user interactions, navigation, and API calls.

classes.name: LookupActivity
classes.description: Main activity for browsing Wiktionary content, managing UI, navigation, and background API calls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, loads layout, animations, and handles incoming intents.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles back key presses to navigate history stack or exit.

methods.name: startNavigating
methods.description: Begins navigation to a specified word, optionally pushing current to history.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for search, random, and about.

methods.name: showAbout
methods.description: Displays an about dialog with data source info.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Processes new intents for search, internal links, or default random word.

methods.name: setEntryTitle
methods.description: Updates the title display for current entry.

methods.name: setEntryContent
methods.description: Loads content into WebView for current entry.

methods.name: onAnimationEnd
methods.description: Shows progress bar after slide-in animation.
